State Of Tennessee Treasury Department Has Lowered Position in Apple (AAPL) by $1.45 Million as Shares Declined; As Dollar Gen New (DG) Stock Price Declined, 12Th Street Asset Management Company Has Raised Stake by $1.90 Million 
April 23, 2018 - By Vivian Park 
State Of Tennessee Treasury Department decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 0.23% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. State Of Tennessee Treasury Department sold 8,606 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 3.75M shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $635.22 million, down from 3.76 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. State Of Tennessee Treasury Department who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $840.87B market cap company. The stock decreased 4.10% or $7.08   $165.72. About 60.26M shares traded or 55.95% up from the average. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49%   7.94% the S&P500. 
12Th Street Asset Management Company Llc increased its stake in Dollar Gen Corp New (DG) by 6.1% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. 12Th Street Asset Management Company Llc bought 20,415 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.52% with the market. The institutional investor held 355,352 shares of the department and specialty retail stores company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $33.05M, up from 334,937 at the end of the previous reported quarter. 12Th Street Asset Management Company Llc who had been investing in Dollar Gen Corp New for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $25.87 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 2.69% or $2.66   $96.34. About 3.68M shares traded or 30.32% up from the average. Dollar General Corporation (NYSE:DG) has risen 34.01%   22.46% the S&P500. 
State Of Tennessee Treasury Department, which manages about $22.36B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Kroger Co (NYSE:KR) by 183,774 shares to 427,931 shares, valued at $11.75 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Cognex Corp (NASDAQ:CGNX) by 100,000 shares in the quarter, for a total of 170,000 shares, and has risen its stake in Dr Pepper Snapple Group Inc (NYSE:DPS).
